text:
emily: FYI — support reported a customer key burning through quota way faster than expected. Seems correlated with requests that trigger tool calls + retries. Putting notes here.

raj: Any sample request_id we can look at? console shows a spike around 11:02 UTC.

emily: example from logs:
```
request_id: req_01F7Z8
org_id: org_989
api_key: key_abc123
model: rwd/fast-v1
prompt_tokens: 42
completion_tokens: 12
tool_calls: [{"name":"search","tokens":38,"call_id":"call_9"}]
retries: 2
```
This one ended up billed ~156 tokens on the key-level chart while our expectation is ~92.

quota-bot: :warning: quota-alert org_989 token burn +210% (3m window) — top key: key_abc123

maria: My guess: billing pipeline currently sums prompt + completion + sum(tool_call.tokens) per attempt. So with retries each attempt adds the tool tokens again.

noah: Streams make it worse — tool_call tokens are counted per-chunk and we currently don't collapse chunks across retries.

raj: Is this per-key only or visible at org aggregation too? might be hidden when aggregated.

emily: We see clear jumps on per-key lines in the console. Org-level curve smoothed but still elevated for some customers.

noah: Short-term mitigation: dedupe tool_call tokens by call_id when parent_request_id is the same and retry=true. Longer-term: add idempotency keys for tool calls and emit a canonical token event once.

maria: Agreed. We'll need tests: e.g. simulate request with retries=2 and tool_call.tokens=50 -> billed tokens should equal prompt+completion+50 (not prompt+completion+150).

raj: I'll draft a PR to change accounting: mark tool tokens as "aux_tokens" and only attribute aux_tokens once per root_request_id. Will also add raw flag `is_retry` to telemetry events.

emily: Add this to rollout checklist: behind feature flag `dedupe_tool_tokens`. Canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Monitor per-key burn rate + top 20 customers.

noah: Edge-case: if tool call is non-idempotent and returns different outputs on retry we may need to bill additional tokens. So dedupe only when `tool_call.idempotent == true` OR when `result_hash` matches.

maria: Plan:
- telemetry: include `tool_call.call_id`, `tool_call.result_hash`, `is_retry` on raw events
- accounting: feature-flagged dedupe by (root_request_id, call_id) with result_hash check
- console: add metric "deduped_tool_tokens" and show per-key delta
- tests: unit + e2e + synthetic customers
- alerts: fire if per-key delta > 25% after rollout

emily: :thumbsup: action owners — raj: PR for accounting; noah: runtime changes to attach call_id/result_hash; maria: billing tests + alerts; emily: console dashboard + rollout plan.

quota-bot: info: feature-flag `dedupe_tool_tokens` scheduled canary 10% at 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z

raj: I'll also add a small retrospective note to the postmortem board so we don't regress when changing the batching layer.

noah: One more runtime note — ensure streaming token events include a stable `chunk_index` and `chunk_hash` to allow collapse.

maria: I'll prioritize a test that reproduces the exact numbers from the customer's report and post the PR link here when ready.

emily: Thanks all. Let's sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC if there are blockers.
